name: EduTube
author: EduTube Open Source
description: Distraction-free YouTube service dedicated strictly to educational courses, university lectures, STEM, programming, and academic content with zero entertainment or brain-rot.

settings.title: Strict Academic Mode
settings.summary: Strictly require videos to originate from verified educational institutions or contain verified academic course keywords.

settings.title: Block All YouTube Shorts
settings.summary: Block all YouTube Shorts and videos shorter than the minimum duration to prevent doom-scrolling.

settings.title: Minimum Video Duration (Seconds)
settings.summary: Discard videos shorter than this threshold (default: 180 seconds / 3 minutes).

settings.title: Block Clickbait Sensationalism
settings.summary: Filter out videos with excessive capital letters, spam emojis, and clickbait patterns.

settings.title: Custom Blocked Keywords
settings.summary: Comma-separated list of additional words or phrases to block from search and feeds.
